All the Holiday Concerts in Colorado Springs 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 15:26
Instaread

At least most of them. Here's how to jingle your way through the holiday season, no matter what your favorite musical style is. There's a full schedule of holiday concerts.

By Jeremy Jones
November 18, 2026

We have a rule in my house: No Christmas music until Thanksgiving. But I’ve been known to cheat here and there for an early preview. I mean, what would the holidays be without the bells and jingles and holiday tunes? Sure there are plenty of cringy classics that get old fast, there are always new songs and interpretations — especially when it comes to live holiday concerts. 

Whether you’re into elegant classical, soulful jazz, rocking around the Christmas tree, seasonal sing-alongs, Irish jigs or a whole band of trombones, here’s a full list of musical performances and holiday concerts in Colorado Springs for everyone. The schedule begins before Thanksgiving, and many regular shows have moved forward on the calendar. So be sure to get your tickets early.

Acoustic and World Concerts

A Celtic Christmas

Nov. 19
Pikes Peak Center

Get ready to be enchanted by a Celtic blend of melodic folk mashups, acapella tap battles and heartwarming storytelling. A Taste of Ireland Company brings its internationally acclaimed holiday spectacular direct from New York’s Off-Broadway and London’s West End.

http://pikespeakcenter.com/

Irish Christmas in America

Nov. 27
Stargazers Theatre

Celebrate Christmas with Irish music, song and jigs. The evocative family-friendly show will bring rich tradition and new energy to your holiday season.

stargazerstheatre.com

Trace Bundy’s Acoustic Holiday

Dec. 11
Stargazers Theatre

The “Acoustic Ninja” brings his dazzling guitar wizardry to this 18th annual holiday show. His music is poetry in motion, using harmonics, looping, multiple capos and his unique banter and stage presence to deliver an unforgettable live concert experience. This year’s annual concert features special guests Andy McKee. This one’s a holiday gift of guitar wizardry.

stargazerstheatre.com

A Winter’s Eve with Megan Burtt

Dec. 20
Millibo Art Theatre

Cozy up at the Millibo for a special and unique holiday set of music with singer-songwriter Megan Burtt and her band. A Winter’s Eve features holiday originals, new versions of old holiday favorites, deep cuts and some musical surprises.

themat.org

Frog & Fiddle Xmas Eve

Dec. 24
The Armadillo Ranch

Spend Christmas Eve with Dylan, Derek and Tim in an evening serenade to spread joy, cheer and an escape from Aunt Linda. Expect some new songs, old favorites and holiday tunes. Come on, it’s Christmas Eve.

manitouarmadilloranch.com

Pop and Rocking Around the Christmas Tree

Trans-Siberian Orchestra: The Ghosts of Christmas Eve

Nov. 22
Broadmoor World Arena

The multi-platinum, Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) brings its rock opera-meets-Christmas-and-classical tour back to the World Arena in what has become a Springs tradition. The Ghosts of Christmas Eve compiles a night of the best of TSO and more, and it will get you head-banging right into the holiday season with a full light show, pyrotechnics and much more. Choose between two performances on Nov. 22.

broadmoorworldarena.com

Blue Violin’s Retro Rock & Roll Christmas

Nov. 29
Ent Center for the Arts

Blue Violin brings an electrifying holiday spectacular blending the energy of an 80s arena rock show with the magic of Christmas. The show has sold out performances from the Sydney Opera House to Carnegie Hall, and now it’s coming to the Ent Center. The cinematic production features a live rock band, soaring choir, breathtaking cathedral projection mapping, and unforgettable violin performances as it reimagines Christmas classics alongside ’80s rock and pop classics.

tickets.entcenterforthearts.org

Collective Groove Holiday Dance Party

Dec. 4
Stargazers Theatre

Shake your groove thang with Collective Groove as they throw down contemporary beats and tunes from the golden age of soul. The nine-piece funk and soul band knows how to light up a room, bringing fat beats and a killer horn section, covering dance hits, holiday tunes and more.

stargazerstheatre.com

Spinphony Holiday Show

Dec. 6
Stargazers Theatre

The four women of Spinphony break down barriers between classical, rock and pop music and they’ll bring a fresh spin(phony) to your holidays. The electric string quartet plays more like a rock band than an orchestral quartet with unique arrangements such as “Bach in Black” and “Don’t Stop Beethoven” and they’ll bring the same creativity to holiday favorites.

stargazerstheatre.com

Jingle Bell Rock for St. Jude

Dec. 12
Sunshine Studios Live

Deathride, 4Peace Man, Saint Trouble, Cobalt Mountain and Teeth will rock the Sunshine Studios stage. Proceeds go to support the work of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital.

sunshinestudioslive.com

Face All Vocal Rock Band

Dec. 12
Stargazers Theatre

Christmas! Christmas!! Christmas!!! is a joyful celebration of the season filled with favorite holiday tunes, incredible vocals, laughter and plenty of Christmas spirit. Face Vocal Band puts its own spin on Christmas in a festive night for all.

stargazerstheatre.com

Harp Twins Rockin’ Christmas Concert, with Special Guests the Volfgang Twins

Dec. 13
Stargazers Theatre

The beautiful Harp Twin sisters team up with the burly Volfgang twin brothers on percussion for a family-friendly concert full of magical winter music, Christmas classics, comedy, stories and classic rock favorites. It’s a Nordic inspired musical night of fire and ice. And there’s a free meet and greet with all the twins.

stargazerstheatre.com

Holiday Musicals and Dance

Irving Berlin’s White Christmas

Nov. 19 – Dec. 27
Fine Arts Center Theatre

Get into the holiday spirit with a heartwarming, classic musical at the FAC. Based on the beloved 1954 film, Irving Berlin’s White Christmas brings romance, friendship, dazzling song-and-dance numbers and holiday magic to the stage. It all comes together in a snowy Vermont lodge when World War II veterans and successful song-and-dance duo Bob Wallace and Phil Davis encounter two talented singing sisters, Betty and Judy Haynes. This show is filled with 17 Irving Berlin songs, including “Blue Skies,” “I Love a Piano,” “How Deep Is the Ocean” and the all-time “White Christmas.” Altogether it’s a nostalgic celebration of music, friendship, generosity and holiday cheer. Raise an Opening Weekend Snowflake Martini on Friday at a festive FAC Libation Lecture before the show.

fac.coloradocollege.edu

@CSFineArtsCenter

The Nutcracker

Nov. 27-29
Colorado Springs Philharmonic at Pikes Peak Center

The Colorado Springs Philharmonic presents its annual Nutcracker performance with the University of Oklahoma School of Dance and the Colorado Springs Children’s Chorale. It’s a timeless classic and a favorite Colorado Springs holiday tradition for the whole family over the Thanksgiving weekend.

csphilharmonic.org

The Christmas Mouse

Dec. 12-20
Millibo Art Theatre

A lovable mouse is out to save her silly neighbors’ Christmas in a delightful holiday musical comedy.

themat.org

Cirque Musica

Dec. 15
Broadmoor World Arena

This brand-new production blends world-class circus artistry with favorite holiday music, bringing the season to life with breathtaking acrobatics and soaring aerial feats. The dazzling winter wonderland draws the show’s stars—and you—back to the joy and imagination of the holidays.

broadmoorworldarena.com

Cask & Chisel’s Room at the Inn

Dec. 22
Millibo Art Theatre

On a snowy Christmas Eve, travelers seeking shelter find their way to a small inn. Each new arrival brings a tune, a story or a bit of mischief. The Colorado Springs Celtic band Cask & Chisel brings the story to life with live Celtic music, humor and a few singalongs. It’s a Christmas show about what happens when we make room for one more.

themat.org

A Colorado Nutcracker

Dec. 22-23
Pikes Peak Center

In this annual tradition, the Colorado Ballet Society and Colorado Youth Ballet perform a local rendition of the famous holiday story. Set in a 1907 Christmas Eve celebration at the Glen Eyrie home of Gen. William J. Palmer, young Clara receives an enchanted nutcracker doll from Nikola Tesla, inventor extraordinaire and special guest at the party. Tchaikovsky’s masterwork music is performed by the Chamber Orchestra of the Springs.

pikespeakcenter.com

Christmas Carols and Classics

Soli Deo Gloria Holiday Kickoff Concert

Nov. 22
Broadmoor Hall at The Broadmoor

The 120-plus member Soli Deo Gloria community choir performs a free concert in Broadmoor Hall, featuring traditional and sacred holiday songs. Tickets are free but must be reserved in advance. Proceeds benefit the Gazette Charities Empty Stocking Fund.

broadmoor.com

Angels and Shepherds: A Baroque Christmas

Nov. 28
Parish House Baroque at Glen Eyrie Castle

Dive into the holiday season with a musical journey to the splendors of Christmas long ago in the halls of Germany and Austria. Vocalists Emily Sorenson and Amalia Dobbins will be accompanied by Parish House Baroque, Colorado Springs’ only professional period instrument ensemble. There is an optional buffet dinner in the Castle Dining Room between the two performances at 4 and 7 p.m.

gleneyrie.org

Glen Eyrie’s Madrigal Banquet

Dec. 2-22
Glen Eyrie Castle

Step back in time in the Great Hall of The Glen Eyrie Castle for a 16th century-style banquet and interactive performance to inspire you for the Christmas season.

gleneyrie.org

Christmas Concert at Village Seven Presbyterian Church

Dec. 4-5
Village Seven Presbyterian Church

Celebrate the hope of the season with new and old versions of beloved Christmas music featuring classical, jazz, pop and gospel featuring the choir, orchestra, soloists, band and dancers. There’s even a storybook reading for kids. This event is free and open to the public.

V7pc.org

O Tannenbaum

Dec. 4 & 6
First United Methodist Church

The historic downtown church presents a German-inspired evening and afternoon of lessons and carols, featuring its Chancel Choir, Chancel Ringers, worship band and festival orchestra.

fumc-cs.org

Colorado Springs Youth Symphony Holiday Pops

Dec. 5
Pikes Peak Center

The Colorado Springs Youth Symphony performs its impressive annual Holiday Celebration concert. This year’s show is the Holiday Pops Concert.

pikespeakcenter.com

Little London Winds Hanukkah Concert

Dec. 6
Temple Shalom

Celebrate the Festival of Lights with a variety of joyous Hanukkah and klezmer music. After the concert and short service, join members of the Little London Winds for refreshments, hosted by the members of Temple Shalom. All faiths are welcome. Pre-registration is required.

littlelondonwinds.org

’Tis the Season: Our Past, Present and Future

Dec. 6
Pikes Peak Center

The Colorado Springs Children’s Chorale presents its annual holiday concert. Join the festive celebration of holiday music from across the globe in the intimate Studio Bee at the Pikes Peak Center.

kidssing.org

Wintersong

Dec. 9-10
Colorado Vocal Arts Ensemble at Shove Chapel, Colorado College

Join this cherished holiday tradition of music, spoken word and candlelight by the Colorado Vocal Arts Ensemble. The favorite Colorado Springs tradition reflects on the mystery and beauty of the intersection of light and dark and spiritual connection to the natural world. Read more about the Wonder of Wintersong from our archives here.

cvae.org

Colorado Springs Conservatory’s Holiday Extravaganz

Dec. 11
First United Methodist Church Theatre

Join the Colorado Springs Conservatory for the fourth annual Holiday Extravaganz. Students will get you into the holiday spirit with original music, treasured classics and everything in between.

coloradospringsconservatory.org

First Pres Presents Christmas Joy!

Dec. 13
Pikes Peak Center for the Performing Arts

First Presbyterian Church’s annual tradition continues with two performances in this musical extravaganza. This year’s performance will showcase holiday favorites and a world premiere of an exclusive Christmas composition by Grammy-nominated composer and conductor Lee Johnson. Among 200 performers are Lloyd Buchanan, Gina Milne, Jonathan Hays, Todd Teske, Judith Meyer, the Crystal Creek Band and the “Big Blue” First Pres choir along with its full orchestra.

pikespeakcenter.com

Christmas Symphony

Dec. 19-20
Pikes Peak Center

The Colorado Springs Philharmonic will fill the air with holiday cheer in its annual holiday concert. They will be joined by the Colorado Springs Chorale Society and Choirs of Colorado Springs to perform festive sing-alongs, holiday favorites and a heartwarming performance that will fill you with holiday spirit.

csphilharmonic.org

Candlelight: Christmas Classics

Dec. 20 & 26
First United Methodist Church Colorado

Enjoy holiday favorites while immersed in the glow of candlelight. The String Quartet – Range Ensemble will perform a long list of holiday classics from all eras.

feverup.com

Little London Christmas Concert

Dec. 20
Bethel Lutheran Church

Join the Little London Winds as they play favorite Christmas tunes to get into the holiday spirit. The concert is free and open to the public regardless of faith and not sponsored by Bethel Lutheran Church.

ittlelondonwinds.org

Country Christmas Concerts in Colorado Springs

Michael Martin Murphey’s Cowboy Christmas

Nov. 22
Phil Long Music Hall

For more than five decades, Michael Martin Murphey has carried the spirit of the American West through a career that spans pop, country, bluegrass, and Americana. His Cowboy Christmas tour is an annual tradition that transports audiences into the heartwarming Western spirit of the season.

phillongmusichall.com

Flying W Christmas at the Ranch

Dec. 3-23, select dates
Flying W Ranch

The Flying W Ranch will twinkle with Christmas lights, from the barn to the rock formations. And the Flying W Wranglers will perform a Cowboy Christmas Jubilee in the Chuckwagon. Of course, there is a full Flying W feast. It’s a classic Colorado experience. Some shows are already sold out.

flyingw.com

Jazz, Big Band, Variety Concerts in Colorado Springs

Canyon Winds Jazz Holiday Show

Dec. 3
Stargazers Theatre

This special holiday performance brings the spirit of the season to life with the smooth, sophisticated sound of jazz and a festive mix of holiday favorites. Canyon Winds Jazz will put their own distinctive spin on beloved Christmas classics, fun dance tunes and plenty of seasonal magic.

stargazerstheatre.com

The Modbo Ho-Ho at the Millibo

Dec. 5-6
Millibo Art Theatre

This R-rated production definitely isn’t for kids, but it’s perfect for some irreverent holiday fun. The beloved Modbo gallery has closed, but its holiday cabaret lives on each year at the Millibo Theatre. Enjoy tawdry songs, laughs, dances and some brief moments of holiday earnestness at this year’s performance.

themat.org

Darci Lynne & Friends Christmas Tour

Dec. 5
Phil Long Music Hall

Ventriloquist, singer, comedian and America’s Got Talent winner Darci Lynne brings her Christmas cheer to Phil Long Music Hall for two shows on Saturday, Dec. 5. The festive, family-friendly production features Christmas favorites, heartwarming moments and appearances from Darci’s beloved cast of characters.

phillongmusichall.com

Yule Be Naughty … Of Course!

Dec. 11-20
Millibo Art Theatre

Join the holiday mischief at the MAT’s cabaret and irreverent celebration of all things December. Join Babette and an all-star cast as they sing, dance, circus and poke fun at the trials and tribulations of this most Merry Season. Enjoy a glass of glogg, the signature holiday cocktail. This show is definitely for adults.

themat.org

The Broadmoor Holiday Show

Dec. 18, 19, 24
The Broadmoor

The annual Broadmoor holiday tradition features a variety dinner show available as part of an overnight package. This year’s all-star lineup features Julie Bradley, Derek Evilsizor, Amy Mushall, Amber Marek, Cheerish Martin, Miriam Roth, international jazz artist Nelson Rangell, and featured guest artist Ilya Shpilberg on violin. Guitarist Wayne Wilkinson, bassist Ron Bland, and drummer Dave Auerbach are joined by Ken Miller, who directs and performs. Even Santa makes a special appearance. The evening blends Broadway, swing, sacred music, and smooth jazz in a heartwarming, high-energy performance.

broadmoor.com/holidays

Trombone Christmas

Dec. 21
Bare Bones Trombone Choir at Black Forest Community Club

As Buddy the Elf would say if he played trombone, “The best way to spread Christmas cheer is playing trombone loud for all to hear.” You can’t help but get some cheer from this free annual concert. All trombones? I mean, come on. Bring that brass! This year you can catch the horns in Black Forest.

@BareBonesTromboneChoir

Dueling Pianos: Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree

Dec. 23
Phil Long Music Hall

Have some festive fun on the night before Christmas Eve. The talented dueling pianists are back for a lively musical showdown filled with holiday cheer. The audience helps choose the soundtrack so bring your favorites and sing-along classics to join in the musical cheer.

phillongmusichall.com

Want to hear holiday music all season? 

Check out this Go-to Colorado Christmas Music Playlist from our archives.
